# Texas, Whiskey & You

> North Texas's premier Chris Stapleton tribute band.

Texas, Whiskey & You (TWY) is a four-piece live tribute to the music of Chris Stapleton. The band is based in North Texas and performs at festivals, music venues, dance halls, wineries, corporate events, weddings, and private parties.

## Facts

- Name: Texas, Whiskey & You
- Also known as: TWY
- Genre: Country tribute
- Based in: North Texas (Dallas–Fort Worth area)
- Tribute artist: Chris Stapleton
- Booking email: sdmbooking@yahoo.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/texaswhiskeyandyou
- Official site: https://twytribute.com

## Lineup

- Chris Rowland — Lead Vocals / Guitar
- Christian Sly — Lead Guitar / Vocals
- Clay Wise — Bass / Vocals
- Tull Rea — Drums / Vocals

## Booking

Submit a date, location, and event type at https://twytribute.com/book. The band can bring a full PA or plug into a house system.
